# Pilot: nowcast, survey path and bottom-up

Median of six fast models (ridge, adaptive lasso, elastic net, kernel ridge, random forest, gradient boosting), monthly origins from 2000, RMSE relative to no change (below 1 beats it).  Sub-periods are by the month being forecast.  `*` marks a Diebold-Mariano p-value below 0.1 against the current features (full sample, better or worse).
